sources.title: TECRA September15 Ome Takinouecho progress report
sources.summary: All three designs and building confirmations complete; land divided for individual building funds. Fund103 takes the first subdivision. Fund operating dates describe the investment vehicle, not data-center operation.

sources.title: Japan ERI building confirmation ERI-26012911, reproduced by TECRA
sources.summary: May27 certificate identifies Ome DC5 building B, server-room warehouse, new steel two-storey building,317.54m² total floor and331.64m² site. Applicant TECRA; old parcel1325-1 part. Matches exact permit reference on successor fund103.

sources.title: OME Data Center05 original three-building Takinouecho campus
sources.summary: Original parcels1325-1 and1328-13 in Takinouecho, Ome. Developer embeds an explicit DMS point35°47′15.4″N139°15′25.0″E for this original campus. Three planned buildings. No operating claim.

sources.title: OME Data Center07 Takinouecho B successor project
sources.summary: Successor to part of fund96. New parcels1325-9 and1325-12; building1325-9. Permit ERI-26012911 links DC5B to OME07. Planned approx2MW maximum received power, steel two-storey317.54m², chiller coolingN+1 and UPSN+1; completion forecastFeb–Mar2027. No commissioned equipment or critical IT capacity asserted.
